title: Lovely Tender Monsoon Malaysian Rainbow Trout Satay
description: Delicate rainbow trout marinated in a blend of miso, coriander, and coconut milk, grilled to perfection and served on a stick with a zesty peanut sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine white miso paste, coconut milk, grated ginger, and coconut sugar. Blend until smooth.
Add trout fillets to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread marinated trout onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes or until trout is cooked through and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, blend together peanuts, coconut milk, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Brush the peanut sauce onto the grilled trout and garnish with chopped cilantro.
